content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
    <title>SQL-Trainer | OSZ IMT</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&family=Outfit:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@10/dist/mermaid.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alasql@4/dist/alasql.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg: #0f0f14;
            --surface: #18181f;
            --surface-hover: #222230;
            --border: #2a2a3a;
            --text: #e8e8f0;
            --text-dim: #8888a0;
            --accent: #00E5FF;
            --success: #00FF94;
            --error: #FF3366;
            --warning: #FFB800;
            --easy: #00FF94;
            --medium: #FFB800;
            --hard: #FF3366;
            --font: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
            --mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
        }

        *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

        html {
            font-size: 16px;
            -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font);
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            min-height: 100vh;
            min-height: 100dvh;
        }

        /* Header */
        header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
            padding-left: max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-left));
            padding-right: max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-right));
            background: var(--surface);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .logo-icon {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--bg);
        }

        h1 {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .stat {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        /* Main */
        .main {
            display: flex;
            height: calc(100vh - 60px);
            height: calc(100dvh - 60px);
        }

        /* Schema Panel */
        .schema-panel {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .panel-header {
            padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            background: var(--surface);
        }

        .panel-body {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 1rem;
            overflow-y: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .mermaid-container {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 1rem;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: grab;
            overflow: auto;
        }

        .mermaid-container:active { cursor: grabbing; }

        .mermaid-container svg {
            max-width: 100%;
        }

        .table-list {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
        }

        .table-list h3 {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .table-list code {
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Task Panel */
        .task-panel {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* Tabs */
        .tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.75rem;
            background: var(--surface);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .tab {
            position: relative;
            padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem;
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            user-select: none;
        }

        .tab:hover { 
            background: var(--surface-hover); 
            color: var(--text);
        }

        .tab:focus-visible {
            outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
            outline-offset: 2px;
        }

        .tab.active { 
            background: var(--surface-hover); 
            border-color: var(--border); 
            color: var(--text);
        }

        .tab.easy.active { 
            color: var(--easy);
            box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--easy);
        }
        .tab.medium.active { 
            color: var(--medium);
            box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--medium);
        }
        .tab.hard.active { 
            color: var(--hard);
            box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--hard);
        }

        /* Task List */
        .task-list-wrap {
            padding: 0.75rem;
            background: var(--surface);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            max-height: 120px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .task-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 0.4rem;
        }

        .task-item {
            padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem;
            background: var(--bg);
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s;
            border-left: 2px solid transparent;
            user-select: none;
            min-height: 36px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .task-item:hover {
            background: var(--surface-hover);
            border-color: var(--border);
            color: var(--text);
            transform: translateX(2px);
        }

        .task-item:focus-visible {
            outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
            outline-offset: 1px;
        }

        .task-item.active { 
            border-left-color: var(--accent); 
            background: var(--surface-hover); 
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .task-item.solved { 
            border-left-color: var(--success); 
            opacity: 0.7; 
        }
        .task-item.solved::after { 
            content: ' ✓'; 
            color: var(--success); 
            margin-left: 0.25rem;
        }
        .task-item .id { 
            font-family: var(--mono); 
            font-weight: 600; 
            color: var(--accent); 
            margin-right: 0.3rem;
        }

        /* Task Content */
        .task-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 0.75rem;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .task-desc {
            padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .task-desc h2 {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .task-desc p { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim); }

        /* Editor */
        .editor-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 120px;
        }

        .editor-head {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
            background: var(--bg);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 0.25rem;
        }

        kbd {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border);
        }

        .sql-editor {
            flex: 1;
            width: 100%;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;
            padding: 0.75rem;
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text);
            resize: none;
            line-height: 1.6;
            caret-color: var(--accent);
        }

        .sql-editor:focus { 
            outline: none; 
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent);
        }
        .sql-editor::placeholder { 
            color: var(--text-dim);
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        /* Buttons */
        .btn-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
            background: var(--bg);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .btn {
            position: relative;
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 80px;
            max-width: 140px;
            padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            user-select: none;
            text-align: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .btn::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: white;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.15s;
        }

        .btn:active::after {
            opacity: 0.1;
        }

        .btn:focus-visible {
            outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
            outline-offset: 2px;
        }

        .btn-primary { 
            background: var(--accent); 
            color: var(--bg); 
            border-color: var(--accent); 
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3);
        }
        .btn-primary:hover { 
            background: #33EAFF;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4);
        }
        .btn-primary:active {
            transform: translateY(0);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .btn-hint { 
            background: var(--warning); 
            color: var(--bg); 
            border-color: var(--warning); 
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(255, 184, 0, 0.3);
        }
        .btn-hint:hover { 
            background: #FFC233;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 184, 0, 0.4);
        }
        .btn-hint:active {
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .btn-secondary { 
            background: var(--surface); 
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .btn-secondary:hover { 
            background: var(--surface-hover); 
            border-color: #3a3a50;
        }
        .btn-secondary:active {
            background: #1a1a28;
        }

        /* Feedback */
        .feedback {
            padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: none;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }
        .feedback.show { 
            display: block;
            animation: feedbackPop 0.3s ease forwards;
        }

        @keyframes feedbackPop {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95) translateY(-5px); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.02) translateY(0); }
            100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
        }

        @keyframes flashGreen {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: none; }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--success), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 148, 0.2); }
        }

        @keyframes flashRed {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: none; }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--error), inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 51, 102, 0.2); }
        }

        .feedback.success { 
            background: rgba(0,255,148,0.1); 
            border: 1px solid var(--success); 
            animation: feedbackPop 0.3s ease forwards, flashGreen 0.6s ease;
        }
        .feedback.error { 
            background: rgba(255,51,102,0.1); 
            border: 1px solid var(--error); 
            animation: feedbackPop 0.3s ease forwards, flashRed 0.6s ease;
        }
        .feedback.warning { 
            background: rgba(255,184,0,0.1); 
            border: 1px solid var(--warning); 
        }
        .feedback h3 { font-size: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }
        .feedback.success h3 { color: var(--success); }
        .feedback.error h3 { color: var(--error); }
        .feedback.warning h3 { color: var(--warning); }
        .feedback p { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-dim); }

        /* Results */
        .results {
            max-height: 160px;
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: none;
        }
        .results.show { 
            display: flex; 
            flex-direction: column; 
        }

        @keyframes borderFlashGreen {
            0%, 100% { border-color: var(--border); }
            50% { border-color: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 148, 0.3); }
        }

        @keyframes borderFlashRed {
            0%, 100% { border-color: var(--border); }
            50% { border-color: var(--error); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 51, 102, 0.3); }
        }

        .results.flash-success {
            animation: borderFlashGreen 0.8s ease;
        }

        .results.flash-error {
            animation: borderFlashRed 0.8s ease;
        }

        /* Editor flash feedback */
        @keyframes editorFlashGreen {
            0% { border-color: var(--border); }
            30% { border-color: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 148, 0.4); }
            100% { border-color: var(--border); }
        }

        @keyframes editorFlashRed {
            0% { border-color: var(--border); }
            30% { border-color: var(--error); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 51, 102, 0.4); }
            100% { border-color: var(--border); }
        }

        .editor-wrap.flash-success {
            animation: editorFlashGreen 0.6s ease;
        }

        .editor-wrap.flash-error {
            animation: editorFlashRed 0.6s ease;
        }

        .results-head {
            padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
            background: var(--bg);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .results-body { flex: 1; overflow: auto; }

        .results-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.75rem; }
        .results-table th {
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            background: var(--surface-hover);
            padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .results-table td { padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-dim); }
        .results-table tr:hover td { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }

        /* Solution */
        .solution { display: none; }
        .solution.show { display: block; }
        .solution pre {
            font-family: var(--mono);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--success);
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 0.75rem;
            white-space: pre-wrap;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 800px), (max-height: 600px) {
            html { font-size: 14px; }

            .main {
                flex-direction: column;
                height: auto;
                min-height: calc(100vh - 60px);
            }

            .schema-panel {
                max-height: 30vh;
                min-height: 200px;
                border-right: none;
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }

            .task-panel {
                flex: 1;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .panel-body {
                flex-direction: row;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }

            .mermaid-container {
                flex: 1;
                min-width: 200px;
            }

            .table-list {
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }

            header {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                gap: 0.75rem;
                justify-content: center;
                padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
            }

            .logo h1 { font-size: 1.1rem; }

            .stats {
                width: 100%;
                justify-content: center;
            }

            .task-list-wrap {
                max-height: 100px;
            }

            .task-content {
                padding: 0.5rem;
                gap: 0.5rem;
            }

            .editor-wrap {
                min-height: 100px;
            }

            .btn-row {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                gap: 0.5rem;
            }

            .btn {
                flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 0.25rem);
                min-width: 100px;
                max-width: none;
                padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
                font-size: 0.85rem;
            }

            .btn-primary, .btn-hint {
                flex: 2 1 calc(50% - 0.25rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            html { font-size: 13px; }

            .mermaid-container {
                display: none;
            }

            .panel-body {
                flex-direction: column;
            }

            .tab {
                padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
                font-size: 0.75rem;
            }

            .task-item {
                padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem;
                font-size: 0.65rem;
            }

            .btn {
                flex: 1 1 100%;
                padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <header>
        <div class="logo">
            <div class="logo-icon">Q</div>
            <h1>SQL-Trainer</h1>
        </div>
        <div class="stats">
            <div class="stat"><div class="stat-value" id="solved">0</div><div class="stat-label">Geloest</div></div>
            <div class="stat"><div class="stat-value" id="total">0</div><div class="stat-label">Gesamt</div></div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <main class="main">
        <!-- Schema Panel -->
        <section class="schema-panel">
            <div class="panel-header">Datenbankschema</div>
            <div class="panel-body">
                <div class="mermaid-container">
                    <div class="mermaid">
erDiagram
    T_Kunden ||--o{ T_Bestellungen : "hat"
    T_Bestellungen ||--o{ T_Positionen : "enthaelt"
    T_Artikel ||--o{ T_Positionen : "in"
    T_MwSt ||--o{ T_Artikel : "hat"
    T_Kunden { int p_kunden_nr PK string nachname string vorname string email string plz string stadt string status }
    T_Bestellungen { int p_bestell_nr PK int f_kunden_nr FK date bestelldatum date lieferdatum decimal gesamtbetrag }
    T_Positionen { int p_pos_nr PK int f_bestell_nr FK int f_artikel_id FK int menge decimal kaufpreis }
    T_Artikel { int p_artikel_nr PK string bezeichnung decimal listenpreis string kategorie string lagerplatz int f_mwst_nr FK }
    T_MwSt { int p_mwst_nr PK decimal satz string bezeichnung }
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="table-list">
                    <h3>Tabellen</h3>
                    <code>
                        T_Kunden (kunden_nr, nachname, vorname, email, plz, stadt, status)<br>
                        T_Bestellungen (bestell_nr, kunden_nr, bestelldatum, lieferdatum, gesamtbetrag)<br>
                        T_Positionen (pos_nr, bestell_nr, artikel_id, menge, kaufpreis)<br>
                        T_Artikel (artikel_nr, bezeichnung, listenpreis, kategorie, lagerplatz, mwst_nr)<br>
                        T_MwSt (mwst_nr, satz, bezeichnung)
                    </code>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <!-- Task Panel -->
        <section class="task-panel">
            <div class="tabs">
                <button class="tab easy active" data-filter="easy">Leicht</button>
                <button class="tab medium" data-filter="medium">Mittel</button>
                <button class="tab hard" data-filter="hard">Schwer</button>
            </div>

            <div class="task-list-wrap">
                <div class="task-list" id="taskList"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="task-content">
                <div class="task-desc">
                    <h2 id="taskTitle">Waehle eine Aufgabe</h2>
                    <p id="taskDesc">Klicke auf eine Aufgabe in der Liste.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="editor-wrap">
                    <div class="editor-head">
                        <span>SQL-Abfrage</span>
                        <span><kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> Ausfuehren</span>
                    </div>
                    <textarea class="sql-editor" id="sqlInput" placeholder="SELECT ..." spellcheck="false"></textarea>
                </div>

                <div class="btn-row">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btnRun">Ausfuehren</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-hint" id="btnHint">Hinweis</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnSol">Loesung</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnNext">Weiter</button>
                </div>

                <div class="feedback" id="feedback"></div>

                <div class="results" id="results">
                    <div class="results-head" id="resultsHead">Ergebnis: 0 Zeilen</div>
                    <div class="results-body">
                        <table class="results-table" id="resultsTable"></table>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="solution" id="solution">
                    <pre id="solutionCode"></pre>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
    </main>

    <script>
        // Data
        const demoData = {
            T_Kunden: [
                { p_kunden_nr: 1, nachname: "Mueller", vorname: "Anna", email: "anna@test.de", plz: "10115", stadt: "Berlin", status: "aktiv" },
                { p_kunden_nr: 2, nachname: "Schmidt", vorname: "Tom", email: "tom@test.de", plz: "10115", stadt: "Berlin", status: "aktiv" },
                { p_kunden_nr: 3, nachname: "Weber", vorname: "Lisa", email: "lisa@test.de", plz: "80331", stadt: "Muenchen", status: "aktiv" },

        const tasks = [

            { id: "S3-06", title: "Warenkorb-Groesse", diff: "hard", desc: "Wie viele Artikel pro Bestellung (Durchschnitt)?", sol: "SELECT AVG(anzahl) AS durchschnitt FROM (SELECT f_bestell_nr, COUNT(*) AS anzahl FROM T_Positionen GROUP BY f_bestell_nr)", kw: ["AVG", "SELECT"] },

            { id: "S3-08", title: "Umsatz-Status", diff: "hard", desc: "Zeige Kunden mit aktuellem Status.", sol: "SELECT k.nachname, k.status, COALESCE(SUM(b.gesamtbetrag), 0) AS umsatz FROM T_Kunden k LEFT JOIN T_Bestellungen b ON k.p_kunden_nr = b.f_kunden_nr GROUP BY k.nachname, k.status", kw: ["LEFT JOIN", "GROUP BY", "COALESCE"] }
        ];

        // State
        let currentTask = null;
        let solvedTasks = new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sqlSolved') || '[]'));
        let currentFilter = 'easy';

        // Schema zoom
        function initSchemaZoom() {
            const container = document.querySelector('.mermaid-container');
            if (!container) return;
            const svg = container.querySelector('svg');
            if (!svg) return;

            let scale = 1, panning = false, startX = 0, startY = 0, tx = 0, ty = 0;

            container.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                scale = Math.min(Math.max(scale * (e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1), 0.3), 4);
                svg.style.transform = `translate(${tx}px,${ty}px) scale(${scale})`;
            }, { passive: false });

            container.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                panning = true;
                startX = e.clientX - tx;
                startY = e.clientY - ty;
            });

            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                if (!panning) return;
                tx = e.clientX - startX;
                ty = e.clientY - startY;
                svg.style.transform = `translate(${tx}px,${ty}px) scale(${scale})`;
            });

            document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { panning = false; });

            container.addEventListener('dblclick', () => {
                scale = 1; tx = 0; ty = 0;
                svg.style.transform = '';
            });
        }

        // Init
        function init() {
            // Mermaid
            function initMermaid() {
                if (typeof mermaid === 'undefined') {
                    setTimeout(initMermaid, 200);
                    return;
                }
                mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, er: { diagramPadding: 20 }, securityLevel: 'loose' });
                mermaid.run({ nodes: document.querySelectorAll('.mermaid') });
            }
            initMermaid();

            // AlaSQL
            ['T_Kunden', 'T_Bestellungen', 'T_Artikel', 'T_Positionen', 'T_MwSt'].forEach(t => {
                alasql('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ' + t);
            });

            alasql('CREATE TABLE T_Kunden (p_kunden_nr INT, nachname STRING, vorname STRING, email STRING, plz STRING, stadt STRING, status STRING)');
            alasql('CREATE TABLE T_Bestellungen (p_bestell_nr INT, f_kunden_nr INT, bestelldatum STRING, lieferdatum STRING, gesamtbetrag DECIMAL)');
            alasql('CREATE TABLE T_Artikel (p_artikel_nr INT, bezeichnung STRING, listenpreis DECIMAL, kategorie STRING, lagerplatz STRING, f_mwst_nr INT)');
            alasql('CREATE TABLE T_Positionen (p_pos_nr INT, f_bestell_nr INT, f_artikel_id INT, menge INT, kaufpreis DECIMAL)');
            alasql('CREATE TABLE T_MwSt (p_mwst_nr INT, satz DECIMAL, bezeichnung STRING)');

            Object.keys(demoData).forEach(table => {
                alasql.tables[table].data = demoData[table];
            });

            // Render
            renderTasks();
            updateStats();

            // Events
            document.getElementById('sqlInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'Enter') runSQL();
            });

            document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
                tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                    tab.classList.add('active');
                    currentFilter = tab.dataset.filter;
                    renderTasks();
                });
            });

            document.getElementById('btnRun').addEventListener('click', runSQL);
            document.getElementById('btnHint').addEventListener('click', showHint);
            document.getElementById('btnSol').addEventListener('click', showSolution);
            document.getElementById('btnNext').addEventListener('click', nextTask);

            setTimeout(initSchemaZoom, 500);
        }

        function renderTasks() {
            const list = document.getElementById('taskList');
            const filtered = tasks.filter(t => t.diff === currentFilter);
            
            list.innerHTML = filtered.map(t => `
                <div class="task-item ${solvedTasks.has(t.id) ? 'solved' : ''} ${currentTask?.id === t.id ? 'active' : ''}" data-id="${t.id}">
                    <span class="id">${t.id}</span>${t.title}
                </div>
            `).join('');

            list.querySelectorAll('.task-item').forEach(item => {
                item.addEventListener('click', () => selectTask(item.dataset.id));
            });
        }

        function selectTask(id) {
            currentTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === id);
            document.getElementById('taskTitle').textContent = currentTask.id + ': ' + currentTask.title;
            document.getElementById('taskDesc').textContent = currentTask.desc;
            document.getElementById('sqlInput').value = '';
            document.getElementById('feedback').className = 'feedback';
            document.getElementById('feedback').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('results').classList.remove('show');
            document.getElementById('solution').classList.remove('show');
            renderTasks();
        }

        function runSQL() {
            if (!currentTask) return showFeedback('warning', 'Waehle zuerst eine Aufgabe!');
            const sql = document.getElementById('sqlInput').value.trim();
            if (!sql) return showFeedback('warning', 'Bitte SQL eingeben!');

            try {
                const results = alasql(sql);
                displayResults(results);
                checkSolution(results);
            } catch (err) {
                showFeedback('error', 'SQL-Fehler: ' + err.message);
                document.getElementById('results').classList.remove('show');
            }
        }

        function displayResults(results) {
            const section = document.getElementById('results');
            const table = document.getElementById('resultsTable');
            const head = document.getElementById('resultsHead');

            section.classList.add('show');

            if (!results || results.length === 0) {
                table.innerHTML = '<tr><td>Keine Ergebnisse</td></tr>';
                head.textContent = 'Ergebnis: 0 Zeilen';
                return;
            }

            head.textContent = 'Ergebnis: ' + results.length + ' Zeile' + (results.length !== 1 ? 'n' : '');

            const cols = Object.keys(results[0]);
            let html = '<thead><tr>';
            cols.forEach(c => html += '<th>' + c + '</th>');
            html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

            results.forEach(row => {
                html += '<tr>';
                cols.forEach(c => {
                    let val = row[c];
                    if (val === null || val === undefined) val = 'NULL';
                    html += '<td>' + val + '</td>';
                });
                html += '</tr>';
            });
            html += '</tbody>';

            table.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function checkSolution(results) {
            if (!currentTask || !results) return;

            try {
                const expected = alasql(currentTask.sol);
                if (JSON.stringify(results) === JSON.stringify(expected)) {
                    markSolved();
                    showFeedback('success', 'Richtig!');
                } else if (results.length === expected.length) {
                    showFeedback('warning', 'Fast! Anzahl stimmt.');
                } else {
                    showFeedback('error', 'Falsch. Erwartet: ' + expected.length + ' Zeilen');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                const sql = document.getElementById('sqlInput').value.toUpperCase();
                const missing = currentTask.kw.filter(k => !sql.includes(k.toUpperCase()));
                if (missing.length === 0) {
                    markSolved();
                    showFeedback('success', 'Loesung akzeptiert!');
                } else {
                    showFeedback('error', 'Fehlt: ' + missing.join(', '));
                }
            }
        }

        function markSolved() {
            solvedTasks.add(currentTask.id);
            localStorage.setItem('sqlSolved', JSON.stringify([...solvedTasks]));
            updateStats();
            renderTasks();
        }

        function updateStats() {
            document.getElementById('solved').textContent = solvedTasks.size;
            document.getElementById('total').textContent = tasks.length;
        }

        function showFeedback(type, msg) {
            const f = document.getElementById('feedback');
            const results = document.getElementById('results');
            const editor = document.querySelector('.editor-wrap');
            const icons = { success: '✓', error: '✗', warning: '!' };
            const titles = { success: 'Erfolg', error: 'Fehler', warning: 'Hinweis' };
            
            // Reset animations
            results.classList.remove('flash-success', 'flash-error');
            editor.classList.remove('flash-success', 'flash-error');
            void results.offsetWidth; // Force reflow
            
            // Add flash classes
            if (type === 'success') {
                results.classList.add('flash-success');
                editor.classList.add('flash-success');
            } else if (type === 'error') {
                results.classList.add('flash-error');
                editor.classList.add('flash-error');
            }
            
            f.className = 'feedback show ' + type;
            f.innerHTML = '<h3>' + icons[type] + ' ' + titles[type] + '</h3><p>' + msg + '</p>';
        }

        function showHint() {
            if (!currentTask) return;
            const hints = {
                L1: "SELECT ... FROM ...",
                L2: "LIKE mit %",
                L3: "WHERE mit >",
                L4: "ORDER BY",
                L5: "IS NULL",
                L6: "COUNT(*)",
                M1: "JOIN ... ON ...",
                M2: "LEFT JOIN",
                M3: "GROUP BY",
                H1: "SUBSTR fuer Datum",
                default: "Versuche es Schritt fuer Schritt"
            };
            showFeedback('warning', hints[currentTask.id.substring(0,2)] || hints.default);
        }

        function showSolution() {
            if (!currentTask) return;
            document.getElementById('solutionCode').textContent = currentTask.sol;
            document.getElementById('solution').classList.add('show');
        }

        function nextTask() {
            if (!currentTask) {
                const first = tasks.find(t => t.diff === currentFilter);
                if (first) selectTask(first.id);
                return;
            }
            const same = tasks.filter(t => t.diff === currentFilter);
            const idx = same.findIndex(t => t.id === currentTask.id);
            selectTask(same[(idx + 1) % same.length].id);
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    </script>
